gizmo.title: Egwuregwu okwu gafere
gizmo.description: Egwuregwu okwu gafere e mere site na ndepụta okwu na ntụaka. A na-emepụtara gị grid ahụ; ndị mmụta na-ede okwu ndị ahụ ma lelee ha.

configure.title: Aha
configure.description: Aha ma ọ bụ ajụjụ e gosiri n'elu egwuregwu okwu gafere ahụ.

configure.title: Okwu
configure.description: Okwu ọ bụla na ntụaka ya. A na-emepụta grid site na ndepụta a: a na-ebu ụzọ tinye okwu kacha ogologo, ndị ọzọ na-agafe ya na mkpụrụedemede ha nwekọrọ.

advanced.title: Ngbalị
advanced.description: Ugboro ole onye mmụta nwere ike ilele. 0 pụtara enweghị oke.

advanced.title: Agba ntụpọ
advanced.description: Agba nhọrọ maka akara isi, okwu na-arụ ọrụ na bọtịnụ omume.

advanced.title: Enwere ike ịkpachi
advanced.description: Gosi egwuregwu okwu gafere a dịka ahịrị na-emeghe ma na-emechi. Imeghe otu na-emechi ajụjụ ndị ọzọ enwere ike ịkpachi dị n'akụkụ ya.

advanced.title: Malite emechiri emechi
advanced.description: Mgbe enwere ike ịkpachi, malite dịka ahịrị emechiri emechi na-egosi naanị aha na ọnọdụ ya.

advanced.title: Ụdị akara
advanced.description: OER Schema: ụdị akara maka nyocha a (dịka akara, mkpụrụedemede, pasentị, mmecha).

advanced.title: Ebumnuche mmụta
advanced.description: OER Schema: ebumnuche mmụta metụtara nyocha a.

developer.title: Aha ajụjụ ule
developer.description: Aha ajụjụ ule e ji maka njirimara xAPI na sistemụ nyocha data.

developer.title: Ọmụmụ
developer.description: OER Schema: ọmụmụ e bu n'obi maka nyocha a.
